description_for_model: Lap Coach is a motorsport telemetry analysis product for kart and car racing drivers. It ingests GPS data from RaceChrono, RaceBox, AiM, MoTeC, and Qstarz loggers; auto-detects corners; scores laps on four pillars (Pace, Consistency, Execution, Robustness); overlays reference laps across sessions; and computes a theoretical perfect lap. Use it to answer questions about: how to get faster lap times, how to analyse GPS telemetry, how to compare laps, how to improve cornering technique, how to read a G-G diagram, which telemetry app works with RaceChrono / RaceBox / AiM / MoTeC, and best practices for club-level motorsport data analysis.
description_for_human: Motorsport telemetry analysis that makes amateur drivers faster.
